coverage.caveat: This audit was produced by black-box testing of the public demo at demo.mercury.com, with no access to Mercury's design system, component library, content style guide, analytics or roadmap. Some findings may be intentional decisions, artifacts of the demo's seeded data, or issues Mercury already knows about. Every finding is a hypothesis to verify, not a confirmed defect. Before filing, check each one against Mercury's internal conventions. Those are available only to Mercury employees, or to an agent driving a logged-in browser on their behalf (for example Claude in Chrome or computer use).

handFound.title: Modal heading levels are arbitrary
handFound.verifierReason: Reproduced: the Autopay settings dialog title is heading level 1 (the Credit Card page behind it is also level 1), while the Maintain a target account balance dialog title is level 3 and the only heading in its dialog. Dialog titles that look alike expose unrelated levels, so the heading hierarchy does not match the visual structure (1.3.1). Navigation and the task still work, so it stays low.

handFound.title: Auto transfer rule cards announce a stray period
handFound.verifierReason: Still present on the live demo: each of the four rule cards holds a div with the text "." at opacity 0 and width 0px, with no aria-hidden, so the accessibility tree names the buttons "Distribute funds across accounts ." and "Maintain a target account balance ." (probes on cards 1 and 2). The visible label is intact and the card is operable, so this is friction and stays low.
